name: Butaritari
introduction: Butaritari, in Kiribati's northern Gilbert Islands, is often described as one of the greenest and most fertile atolls in the country, with lush vegetation and a lagoon well known among sport-fishing visitors.
geography: Unlike many thinner atolls, Butaritari has notably wide, fertile land areas, supporting dense coconut and breadfruit groves alongside its lagoon and reef systems.
practicalNotes: Butaritari is a remote outer island; travel typically requires a domestic flight from Tarawa, and facilities for independent travellers are limited. Specialist sport-fishing operators sometimes arrange trips here — confirm directly with any operator before booking.
